card.name: Live vaccines and drug interaction warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words right after a warning that live vaccines should not be given (with, during, concurrently, within), and the start of 'e.g.' lists of interacting drugs.

modes.label: Live vaccine restriction
modes.description: Linking word or adverb after 'live vaccines should not be given/recommended' before the drug name.
modes.example: Live vaccines should not be given for 30 days before or concurrently<< with>> BENLYSTA as clinical safety has not

modes.label: Interacting drug lists
modes.description: Partway through 'e.g.' or a drug name in lists of interacting drugs.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning forbidden or prohibited, suggesting a 'do not combine' idea.
card.plain: It marks spots in a label where something is not to be combined or given together with the drug.
